052/**
053 * Simple assists for working with database. There is typically a shared
054 * connection, the {@code defaultConnection}.
055 * TODO: clarify spec how many connections are supported.
056 * TODO: instead of RowSet should take RSC since different columns
057 *       could be from different database.
058 */
059// TODO: clarify semantics of how many connections are supported
060public class DbSupportBase implements DbSupport {
061  private final Connection sharedConnection;
062
063  /**
064   * Save the specified connection as the sharedConnection.
065   *
066   * @param sharedConnection
067   */
068  public DbSupportBase(Connection sharedConnection) {
069    if (!SsUtils.isJunit())
070      Objects.requireNonNull(sharedConnection);
071    this.sharedConnection = sharedConnection;
072  }
073
074  /**
075   * {@inheritDoc }
076   */
077  @Override
078  public Connection getSharedConnection() throws SQLException {
079    if (sharedConnection.isClosed())
080      throw new IllegalStateException("Shared connection isClosed");
081    return sharedConnection;
082  }
